newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy metalworker talks resume, union head hopeful.
newsitem.headline: Italy metalworker talks resume, union head hopeful.

text.p: Talks between Italian trades unions and the metalworking sector employers body Federmeccanica over a protracted pay dispute are due to resume later on Thursday and a union leader said he did not rule out an accord being reached.

"The talks will resume at five o'clock (1600 GMT) at the (labour) ministry. We are in a delicate phase which could result in a contract being signed," Sergio D'Antoni, leader of the CISL union, told reporters.

Talks between unions and employers resumed on Monday for the first time in more than a month to try to end the pay dispute which involves some 1.7 million workers. The sector's two-year contract expired in June.
